final_text: Fixed. The `Intersect` function in `bench.adb` had its advance branches swapped: when `A(I) < B(J)`, it was incrementing `J` instead of `I` (and vice versa), so the pointers walked the wrong lists and missed matches. Swapped the two branches to advance the pointer belonging to the smaller value. `check.sh` now reports `common= 4`, matching the expected count.
bash: ls -la && cat README.md && echo --- && cat check.sh
